html:
SMTO-SKL-0190 — The download from GitHub was interrupted

GUID: c4429505-af32-542b-8241-56609f560eb4
Slug: github-file-download-failed
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: github

What happened

  • The connection broke while SMTO was downloading a file from GitHub. SMTO didn't keep the incomplete file, and nothing on GitHub was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the computer running SMTO is connected to the internet and that github.com opens in a browser. The download stopped because the connection to GitHub broke.
  2. Ask the Agent to download the file again. A download only reads from GitHub and no partial file was kept, so repeating it is safe.
  3. If it fails again, wait a few minutes and check whether github.com and its downloads work in a browser on the same network. A busy GitHub or a network filter that blocks GitHub's download servers can cut the same download short each time.

What success looks like

  • The downloaded file appears in the Conversation.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Streaming a GitHub download (workflow logs, Actions artifact or raw contents) into an artifact failed with a requests or OS error; the partial file was not registered.

What this means

  • Download streaming fails with a requests or OS exception. This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.

Why this can happen

  • Download streaming fails with a requests or OS exception.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect safe transfer failure and retained artifact outcome.

How to fix it

  • Check network connectivity from the Server to github.com and its signed download hosts (objects.githubusercontent.com, release-assets.githubusercontent.com, *.blob.core.windows.net) and GitHub's status, then repeat the read-only download; the OSError/RequestException is raised while reading the response stream, and failed downloads never publish partial artifacts. A persistent failure on the same file points to a proxy, firewall or TLS interruption on that host rather than to the artifact store.
  • Retry the read-only download after checking provider availability; partial artifacts are not published.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A deliberate bounded read publishes only complete content.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic adds no GitHub access. Inspect the original receipt and request stage before repeating work; preserve exact account, host, repository and object identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
